info.title: MAGI-2 Complete Parameter Guide
info.description: Combined parameter reference for the 3 models in this MAGI-2 folder. Select a mode via model; required fields and limits are listed below.

post.description:
Complete parameter reference for MAGI-2. Use `model` to select a model in this folder. Required fields and input requirements are listed for each mode.

| Model ID | Mode | Required fields (excluding model) |
|---|---|---|
| `magi-2-text-to-video` | Text-to-Video | `prompt` |
| `magi-2-image-to-video` | Image-to-Video | `prompt`, `image_urls` |
| `magi-2-reference-to-video` | Reference-to-Video | `prompt` + at least one of `image_urls` / `video_urls` / `audio_urls` |

### Text-to-Video

- Generate 1080p videos from text prompts, with synchronized audio by default
- Supports any integer duration from `4`–`30` seconds

### Image-to-Video

- Input 1 image for first-frame video generation, input 2 images for first-last-frame video generation

### Reference-to-Video

- Input reference images (0–10) + reference videos (0–5) + reference audio (0–5) + text prompt to generate video
- At least one of the three reference types is required; they can be combined freely

- Asynchronous processing mode, use the returned task ID to [query status](/en/api-manual/task-management/get-task-detail)
- Generated video links are valid for 7 days, please save them promptly

prompt.description:
**Text-to-Video**

Text prompt describing the desired video. Supports both Chinese and English. Maximum prompt length: 15000 characters

**Note:**
- This model is text-to-video only and does not support `image_urls`, `video_urls`, or `audio_urls` input

**Image-to-Video**

Text prompt describing the desired video. Supports both Chinese and English. Maximum prompt length: 15000 characters

**Note:**
- This model does not support `video_urls` or `audio_urls` input

**Reference-to-Video**

Text prompt describing the desired video. Supports both Chinese and English. Maximum prompt length: 15000 characters
prompt.example: Follow the camera movement and rhythm of the reference video, and have the character from the image dance on a city rooftop to the beat of the reference audio

image_urls.description:
Applies only to: **Image-to-Video**, **Reference-to-Video**

**Image-to-Video**

Image URL array, **1–2 images**

**Image count and behavior:**

| Image Count | Behavior | Role |
|:--------:|------|------|
| 1 image | First-frame image-to-video | Automatically set as `first_frame` |
| 2 images | First-last-frame image-to-video | 1st image → `first_frame`, 2nd image → `last_frame` |

**Image requirements:**
- Max size per image: `30MB`
- URL length per image must not exceed `8192` characters
- Only HTTPS URLs are supported; image URLs must be directly accessible by the server

**Reference-to-Video**

Reference image URL array, **0–10 images**

**Role description:**

| Media Type | Role | Typical Usage |
|---------|------|----------|
| Image | `reference_image` | Character reference, style reference, product image |

**Image requirements:**
- Max size per image: `30MB`
- Only HTTPS URLs are supported; image URLs must be directly accessible by the server

**Note:** At least one of `image_urls`, `video_urls`, or `audio_urls` must be provided

video_urls.description:
Applies only to: **Reference-to-Video**

Reference video URL array, **0–5 videos**

**Role description:**

| Media Type | Role | Typical Usage |
|---------|------|----------|
| Video | `reference_video` | Camera movement reference, motion reference, visual style reference |

**Video requirements:**
- Supported formats: `.mp4`, `.mov`
- Duration per video: `2` ~ `30` seconds, max 5 videos, total duration of all videos ≤ `30` seconds
- Max size per video: `200MB`
- Only HTTPS URLs are supported; video URLs must be directly accessible by the server

**Note:** At least one of `image_urls`, `video_urls`, or `audio_urls` must be provided

audio_urls.description:
Applies only to: **Reference-to-Video**

Reference audio URL array, **0–5 clips**

**Role description:**

| Media Type | Role | Typical Usage |
|---------|------|----------|
| Audio | `reference_audio` | Background music, sound effects, voice/dialogue reference |

**Audio requirements:**
- Supported formats: `.wav`, `.mp3`
- Duration per clip: `2` ~ `30` seconds, max 5 clips, total duration of all audio ≤ `30` seconds
- Max size per clip: `15MB`
- Only HTTPS URLs are supported; audio URLs must be directly accessible by the server

**Note:** At least one of `image_urls`, `video_urls`, or `audio_urls` must be provided

duration.description:
**Text-to-Video / Image-to-Video**

Video duration (seconds), defaults to `5` seconds

**Details:**
- Supports any integer value between `4`–`30` seconds
- Duration directly affects billing

**Reference-to-Video**

Output video duration (seconds), defaults to `5` seconds

**Details:**
- Supports any integer value between `4`–`30` seconds
- Duration directly affects billing

aspect_ratio.description:
**Text-to-Video / Reference-to-Video**

Video aspect ratio, defaults to `16:9`

**Options:**
- `16:9` (landscape), `9:16` (portrait), `1:1` (square), `4:3`, `3:4`, `21:9` (ultrawide)

**Image-to-Video**

Video aspect ratio, defaults to `auto`

**Options:**
- `auto`: chosen automatically from the first-frame image's aspect ratio
- `16:9` (landscape), `9:16` (portrait), `1:1` (square), `4:3`, `3:4`

**Details:**
- The video is generated at the selected aspect ratio; if the first-frame image has a different aspect ratio, the first frame is center-cropped to fit

generate_audio.description:
**Text-to-Video**

Whether to generate synchronized audio, defaults to `true`

**Options:**
- `true`: Video includes synchronized audio (voice, sound effects, background music) at no additional charge. It is recommended to place dialogue within double quotes to optimize audio generation
- `false`: Output silent video

**Image-to-Video / Reference-to-Video**

Whether to generate synchronized audio, defaults to `true`

**Options:**
- `true`: Video includes synchronized audio at no additional charge
- `false`: Output silent video

callback_url.description:
HTTPS callback URL for task completion

**Callback timing:**
- Triggered when the task is completed, failed, or cancelled
- Sent after billing confirmation is complete

**Security restrictions:**
- Only HTTPS protocol is supported
- Callbacks to private IP addresses are prohibited (127.0.0.1, 10.x.x.x, 172.16-31.x.x, 192.168.x.x, etc.)
- URL length must not exceed `2048` characters

**Callback mechanism:**
- Timeout: `10` seconds
- Up to `3` retries after failure (at `1`/`2`/`4` seconds after failure respectively)
- Callback response body format is consistent with the task query endpoint response format
- A 2xx status code is considered successful; other status codes trigger retries

can_cancel.description: Whether the task can be cancelled. MAGI-2 does not support user cancellation; this field always returns `false`.
